verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own repository documents an official SDK, with API docs and a Developers Guide for building extensions. The start-parameter docs add a headless mode for external API clients and UNO acceptor connections, so the core capability exists. Community reports of a painful macro/Python automation experience and an undocumented JavaScript API for Calc suggest the SDK experience is rough. Missing for 10: detail on supported language bindings or packages, in-depth SDK documentation in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of building successfully against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
